PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION IS GRANTED AND LIMITED AS FOLLOWS: AS TO NOS. 4, 5, 6, THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO IDENTIFY THE PREVIOUSLY PRODUCED RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS WITH SUFFICIENT SPECIFICITY THAT THE PROPOUNDING PARTY IS ABLE TO IDENTIFY THE DOCUMENTS AS READILY AS THE RESPONDING PARTY. AS TO NOS. 11-16, THE MOTION IS GRANTED, LIMITED TO WRITTEN COMPLAINTS FILED WITH EACH OF THE AGENCIES RELATING TO ACTS OF DISCRIMINATION OR HARASSMENT COMMITTED IN SAN FRANCISCO IN THE PAST 5 YEARS. AS TO NOS. 23-24, THE MOTION IS GRANTED, LIMITED TO INVESTIGATIONS CONDUCTED BY DEFENDANT INTO ALLEGATIONS OF RACIAL DISCRIMINATION BY THE COMPANY OR ANY INDIVIDUAL EMPLOYEE OF THE COMPANY IN SAN FRANCISCO. FURTHER RESPONSES AND PRODUCTION SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR SANCTIONS IS DENIED. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
